name: ECOFIRS
recent: EcoFirst 近期宣布一项 RM70 million 的集资活动，同时执行主席 Chew Hian Tat 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次买卖公司股份。公司获得延长至 11 月 30 日完成 RM45 million 的槟城土地收购。最新季度营收环比大增但同比减半，净利同比大幅下滑。
notable: 公司宣布一项 RM70 million 的集资活动。
执行主席 Chew Hian Tat 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次在公开市场买卖公司股份。
公司获得延长至 11 月 30 日以完成 RM45 million 的槟城土地收购。
risks: RM70 million 集资活动可能涉及新股发行，需留意对现有股东的摊薄影响。
执行主席在近期有多次股份出售记录。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度，营收为 RM78.659 million，环比增长 92.8%，但同比下降 50.7%；净利为 RM1.831 million，环比增长 277.5%，同比下降 86.9%，净利率为 2.3%。

events.what_en: Deadline for the quarter ending Nov (Bursa rule)

recent_en: EcoFirst recently announced a RM70 million fundraise, while Executive Chairman Chew Hian Tat traded company shares multiple times from late October to mid-November. The company obtained an extension until 30 November to complete its RM45 million Penang land purchases. Latest quarterly revenue rose sharply QoQ but halved YoY, with net profit declining significantly YoY.
notable_en: The company announced a RM70 million fundraise.
Executive Chairman Chew Hian Tat traded company shares in the open market multiple times from late October to mid-November.
The company obtained an extension until 30 November to complete its RM45 million Penang land purchases.
risks_en: The RM70 million fundraise may involve new share issuance, and its potential dilution impact on existing shareholders should be noted.
The Executive Chairman has recorded multiple share disposals recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM78.659 million, up 92.8% QoQ but down 50.7% YoY; net profit was RM1.831 million, up 277.5% QoQ but down 86.9% YoY, with a net margin of 2.3%.
